previous_selected10_independent_finding.title: The future grant does not bind its full effect scope and omits mandatory effect checks
previous_selected10_independent_finding.trigger: A future exact reference has the same source/product authorization fields but wider effects/home/provider/cases/clock/resources, or grants original_frontend/private_pty while omitting session_db/plugin_state/network/owned_worker/private_pipe.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.defect: Root authorization comparison omits those grant fields and caller protocol. Native frontend construction opens SessionDB and can perform provider/local-model discovery before model_inference is checked; session_db/plugin_state/network/owned_worker effects are declared but never required anywhere. A PTY/StringIO fixture also always creates private pipes without requiring private_pipe. Source equality alone is not an authorization for these additional effects.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.change: Bind the complete native grant/protocol/case-plan/host/home/constructor/effect/resource/deadline scope to the fresh Root authorization and independent qualification. Require every unavoidable effect before its first constructor/action, or reject the plan/provider that would require it. Keep the existing isolatedGo model/network prohibition intact; no mock or widened permission is a fix.
previous_selected10_independent_finding.qualification: No grant supplied or execution attempted; this is a defect in the future proposal's Source enforcement, not a runtime authorization request.
